mechanism: Semantic memory from offline-built library knowledge bases plus a per-run episodic memory of execution records
evidence_scope: The Semantic Memory Module St enhances the LLM's parametric knowledge with domain-specific information from external knowledge bases at each iteration t.
evidence_role: We introduce MLZero, a novel multi-agent framework powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) that enables end-to-end ML automation across diverse data modalities with minimal human intervention.
